metadata.chapter_subtitle: 3D structure from laser ranging—measuring topography and vegetation

inventory.summary: The chapter needed a clearer workflow bridge from raw points to classified and derived surfaces.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
The relationship between raw point clouds and derived terrain products needed stronger early framing.
The processing workflow benefited from a clearer conceptual entry point.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding and clarified the point-cloud-to-product workflow.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified that point clouds are raw geometry rather than finished surfaces.
Improved the workflow framing before classification and interpolation.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces LiDAR processing in a more stepwise and reader-friendly way.

repair.summary: The workflow-pacing issue was repaired during the editorial pass.
actions_taken: Clarified the difference between raw returns and derived surfaces.
Improved the transition into classification and surface extraction.

design_review.summary: The chapter's point-cloud workflow and derived-product visuals now have better interpretive support.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support around the journey from 3D points to terrain and canopy models.
